Messages.Author: Pullen
Messages.Body:
When is the card Feline Saboteur forces you to discard replaced, before or after the 4 burned from the second part of the card?

Feline Saboteur
Type: Action
Requires: Animalism & Obfuscate
[ani][obf]  Choose any Methuselah. The chosen Methuselah discards 1 card at random from his or her hand.
[ANI][OBF] As [ani][obf] above, and the chosen Methuselah burns the top 4 cards of his or her library as well.

Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
before. All the cards effects take place simultaneously.
